title: Better than the smaller round Presto deep fryer.
text: Better than the smaller round Presto deep fryer.. Better than the smaller round Presto deep fryer. Works well with French Fries. Has one major problem. It has some very sharp edges on the sheet metal oil pot that will cut you if you don't file them smooth. Also has sharp edges on the plastic handles. After less than 24 uses the heating element would not turn off when set temperature was reached.
